claims.text: Raffles Udaipur is the first Raffles hotel in India.

findings.quote: this contemporary reimagining of a country mansion is the first Raffles hotel in India.
India’s first Raffles is set on a 21-acre island

claims.text: The resort spans a private island and a lakeshore, and a stay begins with a boat ride.

findings.quote: Raffles Udaipur spans a private island and serene lakeshore. Begin your journey with a graceful boat ride

claims.text: The resort is 20 minutes from the airport.

findings.quote: Just 20 minutes from the airport

claims.text: A limousine takes guests from the airport to a lakeside pavilion, where a private boat transfer waits.

findings.quote: Our luxurious limousine service will whisk you seamlessly from the airport to our lakeside pavilion where your private boat transfer awaits.

claims.text: Local Mewari elements such as jali panels and Tikri artwork appear across the design.

findings.quote: Local Mewari elements such as jali panels and the iconic Tikri artwork further showcase this stunning blend of two distinct geographies.

claims.text: All rooms have a balcony with lake views; many have a private pool, a garden or both.

findings.quote: All have a generous balcony with breathtaking lake views; many have a private pool, a beautifully manicured garden or both.

claims.text: Every suite has a panoramic view of the lake.

findings.quote: Every suite has a panoramic view of the lake

claims.text: Raffles Butlers are available 24 hours a day.

findings.quote: our Raffles Butlers are on hand 24 hours a day

claims.text: Raffles Spa pairs ayurveda-inspired healing practices with contemporary wellness treatments.

findings.quote: an impeccable blend of ayurveda-inspired healing practices and contemporary wellness treatments

claims.text: The spa's Presidential Couples Suite has a steam area, sauna, Jacuzzi and a private balcony overlooking the lake.

findings.quote: the Presidential Couples Suite, featuring a steam area, sauna, Jacuzzi and private balcony overlooking the lake.

claims.text: The Voyagers Den offers badminton, table tennis, pool, board games, PS 5 and croquet.

findings.quote: Badminton, Table tennis, pool, board games, PS 5, croquet are offered in the Voyagers Den.

claims.text: Evenings can begin with an Evening Aarti by Udai Sagar Lake, followed by folk music and traditional dance performances.

findings.quote: your evening begins with the serene Evening Aarti by Udai Sagar Lake, followed by vibrant folk music and traditional dance performances

claims.text: Raffles Udaipur is set on a 21-acre private island.

findings.quote: Set on a 21-acre private island

claims.text: The principal building is inspired by classical European Palladian architecture, with domes and high ceilings, surrounded by Baroque gardens.

findings.quote: The structure of the principal building is inspired by classical European Palladian architecture, featuring domes and high ceilings, and surrounded by beautiful Baroque gardens.

claims.text: Sawai Kitchen serves rediscovered heirloom recipes from the Rajputana royal households, using local seasonal produce and traditional cooking techniques.

findings.quote: Rediscovered heirloom recipes from the Rajputana royal households are lovingly prepared by blending local seasonal produce with traditional cooking techniques.

claims.text: Suites have a manicured garden and a private plunge pool.

findings.quote: a manicured garden and private plunge pool

claims.text: Lakeshore Accommodation offers rooms and suites in non-island Lakeshore residences overlooking Udai Sagar Lake, with access to island dining and experiences.

findings.quote: Set within the tranquil non-island Lakeshore residences, Lakeshore Accommodation at Raffles Udaipur offers refined rooms and suites overlooking Udai Sagar Lake.
guests enjoy signature Raffles service with seamless access to island dining and experiences.

claims.text: Lakeshore Accommodation is in non-island residences, not on the private island itself.

findings.quote: Set within the tranquil non-island Lakeshore residences

claims.text: Arrival from the airport ends with a private boat transfer from a lakeside pavilion.

findings.quote: from the airport to our lakeside pavilion where your private boat transfer awaits.

claims.text: The hotel gives September to March as the ideal time to visit, when the weather is pleasant for outdoor activities.

findings.quote: The ideal time is from September to March when the weather is pleasant for outdoor activities and sightseeing.
